title: Eleven Years and One Number
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：contact　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contact 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my aunt ① made contact with a cousin who had moved eleven counties away, and she said the making was the whole of the letter. The ② contact, meaning the reaching and not the number, took one stamp and stayed made; contact, she said, is the only thing between two houses that is judged by how easily it is kept up.

Every ③ contact in that address book had the same crossing out, and the ④ contact at the end, meaning the one she kept for the emergencies and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever rang twice. Contact, my mother said, is nine parts keeping up and one part somebody willing to dial; my aunt said the dialling is the part that fills the book.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ contact was the whole of the job, meaning the person he knew and not the reaching out. The ⑥ contact, meaning the person and not any of that, is the only thing in a job that everybody mentions and nobody introduces; contact, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a reaching and a person. She said the person is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ contact had become a line in a card index, and the index had become an argument about the crossing out. The ⑧ contact of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in September, was one stamp and thirty years of keeping up; contact, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to dial. He said the dialling was never mentioned.

The ⑨ contact I remember is the one at the end, which she rang in 1979 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ contact, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being kept up; every contact, she said, is a person that has agreed to look like a reaching. She said the person was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 联系（指那种取得联络本身，与那个号码相对）
C. 固定搭配：make contact with sb 与某人取得联系
D. n. 联系人（指那本地址簿里每一位）
E. n. 联系人（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 人脉；门路（指工作上认识的人）
G. n. 联系人（指卡片索引里提到的那一位）
H. n. 接触；交往（抽象总称）

items.q: made contact with a cousin who had moved eleven counties away
The contact, meaning the reaching and not the number
Every contact in that address book
contact was the whole of the job
the contact had become a line in a card index
The contact of the whole thing
A contact, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: make contact with sb 意为“与某人取得联系”，1965 年姑姑与一位搬到十一个郡之外的表亲取得了联系。
contact 意为“联系”，指那种取得联络本身而不是那个号码，一张邮票就够了，并且一直保持着。
contact 指那本地址簿里每一位联系人，每一位都被同样地划掉过。
contact 指末尾那一位（她留给急事的那一栏），是唯一有人打过两次的。
contact 意为“人脉、门路”，父亲说那个人脉就是那份工作的全部，指的是他认识的人而不是取得联络。
contact 为另一个义项，指工作上认识的那个人而不是取得联络，是工作里人人都提起、却无人引见的东西。
contact 意为“联系人”，指卡片索引里提到的那一位，到 1973 年这位联系人成了索引里的一行。
contact 意为“接触、交往”，姑姑九月写道，整件事的交往是一张邮票三十年的保持联络。
contact 意为“联系、联络”，我记得的是末尾那一栏，她 1979 年打过，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
contact 为抽象总称，母亲说一份联系是唯一会因为被保持而变好的东西。
